style: Dark glass UI motion graphic, matching the two sibling service-card animations already in production on albercabrera.com (a browser-with-clicking-cursor card and an Email→IA→Agenda/Factura node-flow card with animated SVG wires). Minimal, premium, quiet — not decorative. Linear-icon language (Lucide-style, stroke-width 2, rounded caps/joins), no fills except the cobalt accent and the central panel glass surface. No text/copy in-shot (silent card visual, message is carried by the surrounding UI card, not by this loop).

customize.hub_treatment: glass dark panel, cobalt gradient border/glow, small live-status pulse (dot or ring) instead of any numeric KPI

shot_brief: Four scattered, dispersed data-source icons (WhatsApp, Email, a spreadsheet, a calendar) sit loosely around the edges of the frame, faint and slightly adrift. In a single dominant motion, cobalt-gradient SVG wires draw on from each source and pull inward, converging into one central glass panel that assembles/locks into place at the center — its border catching the #aebbff→#5275ff→#3b5eff gradient and a small live-status pulse animating once it settles, reading as 'always current' rather than 'growing'. No numbers, no growth chart, no count-up — the entire idea is convergence and live status, not performance. Motion is the message: dispersed → connected → centralized, in one continuous move, looping seamlessly back to the scattered start for autoplay.
